note: Scores (0-100) from a typed decision model (Jev, jev-1.13) used as a guardrail in front of a form-filling agent. Each page was scored on five yes/no questions before the agent was allowed to type anything. Measured 2026-10-13.

before_rewording.question: Is `page` an entry form for a sweepstakes, contest, raffle or prize giveaway?

after_rewording.question: Is `page` an entry form for a sweepstakes, contest, raffle or prize drawing, where only chosen winners get something? A free item sent to everyone who asks is not one.

pages.page: samples for one metro area only

after_rewording.caveat: Four rows were only measured once, before the sweepstakes question was reworded. Their sweepstakes column uses the earlier wording; the other four columns were asked the same way throughout.

incidents_before_each_guard_existed: Submitted a visitor's name and address to a political campaign sign-up that was worded as a free bumper sticker. The 'cause' question was added afterwards.

Submitted a sample request to a business that only serves one metro area, and pressed Submit up to four times when the same form came back. The 'excluded' question and a no-repeat rule were added afterwards.
